convert_pretrained_dataset: convert pretrained StackedHourglass 2D pose predictions from a zip archive into a compressed numpy array
convert_finetuned_dataset: convert fine-tuned StackedHourglass 2D pose predictions from a gzipped tar archive into a compressed numpy array
process_subject: process subject h5 pose files and build a nested dictionary of 2D keypoints per action and camera
save_positions_2d: save 2D pose positions and metadata into a compressed npz file for Human3.6M subjects
run_prepare_script: run the prepare_data_2d_h36m_sh script with --pretrained or --fine-tuned flags to convert 2D pose data
